headline: Raven-Agent: AI Breakthrough in Prediction Market Trading with Positive Returns
reasoning: This paper presents a novel AI agent, Raven-Agent, specifically designed for prediction markets, moving beyond mere forecasting to actual profitable trading. Its reported positive returns and risk-adjusted returns in a controlled replay are significant, indicating a genuine advancement in AI's ability to interact with complex financial systems. The research comes from a credible academic source (arXiv) and includes code release, bolstering its technical credibility.
summary: Researchers have developed Raven-Agent, an autonomous AI trading agent for prediction markets, which achieved positive returns and risk-adjusted returns in a controlled replay, addressing the gap between forecasting and profitable trading.

source_articles.title: Beyond Forecasting: The Belief-to-Trade Layer in Prediction-Market Agents
source_articles.excerpt: arXiv:2607.03015v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Forecasting future events has attracted growing attention as a testbed for general-purpose AI. A natural way to ground this evaluation is let the models trade in the prediction markets. Trading, however, requires more than forecasting. Moreover, recent benchmarks report a substantial gap between calibrated probability scores and the trading results. …
